Engagement Ring Customer Leads

Looking to connect with people ready to buy an engagement ring? CaratBase delivers verified local leads directly to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers. Start with three free leads and pay only $40 for each accepted lead after that.

How It Works

  • Instant Access – No account setup required. Just sign up and receive your first three leads for free.
  • Verified Contacts – Each lead is confirmed to be a genuine buyer searching for an engagement ring.
  • Local Focus – Leads are sourced from your metro area, ensuring you reach customers nearby.
  • Cost‑Effective – After the free trial, each accepted lead costs $40.

Why Choose CaratBase

  • Targeted Reach – Only buyers looking to purchase an engagement ring are added to your list.
  • No Overhead – No subscription fees or hidden costs.
  • Scalable – Start locally in Atlanta and expand to other metros as your business grows.
  • Optional Valuation Widget – Add a $29/month valuation tool to your website to capture more leads directly.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are the first three leads truly free? A: Yes. You receive three verified local leads at no cost before any charges apply.

Q: What happens after the free trial? A: Each lead you accept will cost $40. You can stop at any time; no recurring fees unless you opt for the valuation widget.

Q: Can I use the leads on my website? A: Absolutely. The optional valuation widget integrates with your site, allowing visitors to get a quick appraisal and submit their contact details.

Get Started Today

Ready to grow your customer base with high‑quality engagement ring buyers? Sign up for your free trial now.
